jobs.title: Associate Specialty Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
*This position is National Remote. You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in Minneapolis, Virginia, Maryland, or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office for a minimum of four (4\) days per week.*


Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. **Connecting. Growing together.**


Jobs that support new business sales efforts or account management but are not ultimately responsible for the results. Jobs that manage these employees should also fall under this category. Jobs in this family are typically not in sales bands.

**Job Function Description:**

* Manages ongoing contract relationships and service delivery to clients for one or more accounts.
* Acts as outward\-facing, dedicated resource for assigned accounts, typically with direct client contact (not call center) and large or complex accounts.
* Builds relationships with employer/group clients (not individual members) and serves as the primary point of contact for overall and day\-today service delivery.
* Represents client internally and coordinates with other functions to implement client systems, complete projects, and address ongoing service needs. This function includes employees who are in dedicated on\-site service roles.
* Jobs in this function may work closely with sales on renewals and upselling, but incumbents do not have specific sales goal accountability or primary responsibility to close sales.
* Account management jobs focused primarily on relationship and service management belong in this family; jobs with significant sales responsibilities or sales\-related incentives (including "OTH" plans) belong in a sales band.


This position is full\-time Monday \- Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8am \- 5pm local time zone. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.


We offer weeks of paid training. The hours of training will be based on your schedule or will be discussed on your first day of employment.

  



**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manages Specialty implementation for the least complex Optum Rx clients, e.g., UMR, MedalistRx and some TPA clients
* Acts as outward\-facing resource for multiple assigned accounts with minimal direct client contact (not call center)
* Builds relationships with clients or internal client representatives (not individual members)
* Represents client internally and coordinates with other functions to implement client systems, complete projects, and establish service for ongoing operation.
* May travel to client site or OptumRx service centers to provide consultative services and recommendations (less than 10%)
* Analyzes reports to determine client trends, recommendations, and implements programs appropriate for the client
* Works with other departments to develop operational solutions and recommendations
* May monitor new patient transition to Optum Specialty Pharmacy during first 30 days after Go Live date.
* Transitions client to account management for ongoing service once implementation is complete
* Participates in one or more Implementation Improvement teams and may be responsible for improvement project execution

  



You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma / GED
* Must be 18 years of age OR older
* 1\+ years of Pharmacy Benefit Management or Healthcare Management experience
* 1\+ years working in a client management or client implementation role
* Advanced beginner knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint
* Ability to work full\-time Monday \- Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8am \- 5pm local time zone. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3\+ years Operations or Customer Service experience
* 1\+ years Project Management experience
* Online reporting database experience
* Experience presenting to clients

**Telecommuting Requirements:**

* Ability to keep all company sensitive documents secure (if applicable)
* Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separated from other living areas and provides information privacy
* Must live in a location that can receive a UnitedHealth Group approved high\-speed internet connection or leverage an existing high\-speed internet service

**Soft Skills:**

* Ability to multitask to resolution / completion
* Ability to work cross functionality
* Ability to problem solve / formulate solutions from experience or research

  



* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

  



Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $29 \- $52 per hour based on full\-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

***Application Deadline:*** *This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone\-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income\-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

*UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.*

*UnitedHealth Group is a drug \- free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

jobs.title: Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Build the Client Experience From the Ground Up**



Service Point Pro is a growing company building a modern platform designed to help service businesses operate more effectively. As we bring our platform to market and onboard our first customers, we're looking for an experienced **Onboarding \& Training Specialist** to help define what an exceptional client experience looks like.



This is not simply a training or customer support position. You'll own the client onboarding journey, develop scalable training resources and processes, and become a trusted subject\-matter expert on the Service Point Pro platform.


**What You'll Do**


* Own client onboarding from kickoff and account setup through a successful, on\-time go\-live and confident platform adoption.


* Coordinate client data preparation, imports, account configuration, and launch readiness.


* Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarding questions, issues, and escalations.


* Track onboarding milestones, blockers, and client status to ensure successful implementation.


* Lead live and recorded software training for new and existing clients.


* Develop and maintain training resources, guides, walkthroughs, FAQs, and supporting documentation.


* Build and continuously improve scalable onboarding playbooks, procedures, and workflows.


* Conduct post\-launch success reviews to evaluate adoption, gather feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement.


* Identify client trends, adoption challenges, and feature requests and translate those insights into recommendations for Product and Member Success.


* Serve as a subject\-matter expert on the Service Point Pro platform and client onboarding experience.


**What We're Looking For**


* 5\+ years of experience in client onboarding, customer success, implementation, training, enablement, or a related field.


* Experience independently managing client relationships or onboarding programs from start to finish.


* Demonstrated experience building onboarding processes, training programs, playbooks, or documentation.


* Excellent communication, presentation, and training abilities.


* Ability to make technical concepts understandable for users with varying levels of technical experience.


* Strong organization, prioritization, and problem\-solving skills.


* Self\-directed and comfortable working with autonomy in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.


* Strong customer focus and commitment to delivering exceptional client experience.


**Preferred Experience**



Experience with SaaS platforms, mobile applications, Jira, Confluence, Slack, spreadsheets, CSV imports, data onboarding, or similar technology environments is preferred. Experience helping build an onboarding or customer success function in an early\-stage company is a plus.


**Why Service Point Pro?**



This is an opportunity to join Service Point Pro at an important stage of growth. Rather than inheriting a mature onboarding function, you'll help build the processes, training resources, and client experience that the company will scale on.



You'll work closely with department leadership and cross\-functional partners while having meaningful ownership over how customers experience and adopt the platform.



Compensation: $65,000–$85,000 annually, based on experience, qualifications, and geographic market.



Location: Remote

jobs.title: Training Specialist (HOA & COA Management)
jobs.description:
Description:
**Training Specialist**

**Company:** Cusick Community Management  

**Location:** Charlotte, NC  

**Work Arrangement:** Primarily in\-office, with a minimum of three days per week. Full in\-office presence is expected during new hire onboarding weeks and major program rollouts.  

**Reports To:** President  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Salaried

**Position Summary**


Cusick Community Management is seeking an experienced and highly organized **Training Specialist** to own and lead the company's employee training, onboarding, systems education, program rollouts, and board training initiatives.


This position will play a key role in ensuring employees have the knowledge, resources, and tools necessary to be successful in their roles. The Training Specialist will oversee the new hire experience from onboarding through the ramp period, develop training materials and programs, provide systems training, and serve as a subject matter expert for key platforms including CINC, HOAce, AvidXchange, and Vonage.


The Training Specialist will also work closely with the President and Regional Directors on company\-wide initiatives and will lead the initial training and rollout of new programs, processes, and systems. This position will also be responsible for providing training to boards of directors for communities transitioning to Cusick Community Management.

**Essential Responsibilities**

### **Employee Onboarding**

* Own the new hire experience from the employee's first day through completion of the onboarding and ramp period.
* Coordinate department\-specific onboarding with department leaders and provide training directly when appropriate.
* Develop, maintain, and update onboarding plans for each position.
* Ensure training materials remain current as company processes and procedures evolve.
* Administer competency checks to ensure new hires understand their responsibilities and can effectively perform their jobs before completing onboarding.

### **Systems Training \& Expertise**

* Serve as the internal training expert and first point of escalation for CINC, HOAce, AvidXchange, and Vonage.
* Develop and maintain role\-specific training curriculums for each platform.
* Ensure employees understand how systems should be used based on their specific responsibilities.
* Maintain consistency in how systems are configured and utilized across communities and departments.
* Evaluate new system releases and features and determine their impact and applicability to Cusick.
* Lead training and adoption of applicable system updates and enhancements.
* Coordinate user setup and permissions with system owners.
* Ensure system access is properly provisioned during onboarding and revoked during employee offboarding.

### **Program Launch \& Implementation**

* Design and deliver the initial training for new programs, processes, and system changes.
* Develop training materials, presentations, job aids, and competency assessments for new initiatives.
* Work directly with the President regarding company\-wide rollout priorities and timing.
* Prepare Regional Directors and other leaders to reinforce new programs after the initial implementation.
* Monitor adoption following implementation and identify areas requiring additional training or reinforcement.
* Return to provide additional training when programs or processes are not being consistently adopted.

### **Ongoing Training \& Development**

* Develop and maintain an ongoing training plan to ensure employees remain current as systems, statutes, and company processes change.
* Maintain training materials, study guides, reference materials, and job aids across departments.
* Meet regularly with Regional Directors and department supervisors to identify training gaps and areas where employees may need additional support.
* Develop targeted training programs when a recurring issue requires structured instruction rather than one\-on\-one coaching.
* Confirm employee understanding and competency following targeted training.
* Identify recurring issues across multiple employees and escalate patterns to leadership when they may indicate a larger process or operational issue.

### **Board Training**

* Provide onboarding and training for every new board transitioning to Cusick Community Management.
* Train board members on CINC portal functionality and clarify the respective responsibilities of the board and management company.
* Maintain and update board training materials and curriculum.
* Provide boards with reference materials they can utilize following training sessions.
* Conduct annual refresher training following board elections to account for board member turnover.
* Coordinate with the Community Association Manager and Regional Director to ensure board training is tailored to the specific community.
* Maintain accurate records of which communities have completed board training and when training occurred.

### **Employee Offboarding**

* Own and coordinate the employee offboarding process in partnership with supervisors, HR, and IT.
* Complete the company's offboarding checklist, including same\-day system access revocation.
* Coordinate equipment returns and required documentation.
* Ensure departing employees acknowledge applicable confidentiality and restrictive covenant obligations.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer and account reassignment with the employee's supervisor.
* Maintain complete and accurate offboarding documentation.


Requirements:
**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 3\+ years of experience in training, learning and development, or a supervisory position with significant training responsibilities.
* Community association management experience is preferred.
* Experience with **CINC Systems** is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with AvidXchange, Vonage or comparable VoIP systems, and AI\-assisted workflow tools is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to build training programs and materials from the ground up.
* Strong ability to understand and communicate technical information across multiple departments.
* Excellent presentation and facilitation skills with both individuals and groups.
* Comfortable delivering training in person as well as virtually.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, supervisors, leadership, and client\-facing audiences.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to exercise discretion and sound judgment when handling employee offboarding and performance\-related training matters.

**What Success Looks Like: Success in this position will be measured by:**

* Reduced time to productivity for new hires.
* Successful completion of employee competency checks.
* Strong adoption of new systems, programs, and processes.
* Reduction in repeat errors and escalations involving trained responsibilities.
* Completion of board training for transitioning communities within established timelines.
* Consistent annual board refresher training.
* Accurate and timely completion of employee offboarding requirements.
* Positive feedback from supervisors and Regional Directors regarding training effectiveness and responsiveness.

**About Cusick Community Management**

  

Cusick Community Management is a division of Summit Management Partners serving more than 300 communities throughout the Carolinas. The company operates from offices in **Charlotte, Rock Hill, and Raleigh** and provides community association management services to communities throughout the region.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Karbon**



Karbon is the global leader in AI\-powered practice management software for accounting firms. We provide an award\-winning cloud platform that helps tens of thousands of accounting professionals work more efficiently and collaboratively every day. With customers in 40 countries, we have grown into a globally distributed team across the US, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the Philippines. We are well\-funded, ranked \#1 on G2, growing rapidly, and have a people\-first culture that is recognized with Great Place To Work® certification and on Fortune magazine's Best Small Workplaces™ List.

**About the Role:**



As a Senior Implementation Specialist at Karbon, you'll serve as the trusted guide for our largest customers, leading them through onboarding, data migration, implementation, and training. You'll act as the project manager, consultant, and change management coach, ensuring customers achieve rapid time\-to\-value and long\-term success on the Karbon platform.


**As a Senior Implementation Specialist, you will...**


* **Own the customer implementation journey**: Act as the project manager for enterprise accounts, building and maintaining detailed project plans, tracking milestones, and ensuring all deliverables are completed on time.
* **Communicate across multiple stakeholders**: Partner with executive sponsors, firm administrators, and end users to align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and drive accountability.
* **Facilitate structured onboarding**: Lead kickoff meetings, consultative process reviews, configuration workshops, and training sessions tailored to firm needs.
* **Provide professional guidance**: Advise customers on best practices in workflow design, firm operations, and change management to maximize adoption and business impact.
* **Coach through change management**: Help firms prepare their teams for new processes, encouraging adoption and managing resistance.
* **Ensure data integrity**: Support customers in importing contacts and work items, leveraging Excel and other tools to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* **Identify and mitigate risks**: Spot early warning signs of delays or adoption issues and proactively intervene to keep projects on track.
* **Collaborate internally**: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Support teams to ensure seamless customer handoffs and capture valuable feedback.
* **Deliver measurable value**: Drive outcomes that demonstrate ROI for customers and set them up for long\-term success with Karbon.
* Use **AI** in day\-to\-day implementation work, including ChatGPT licenses and AI\-driven workflow automations, to support project planning, customer communications, and process optimization.


**About You**


* You have 3\-5\+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Implementations
* You have 2\+ years of end\-to\-end technical implementation experience
* You are experienced in project management and comfortable managing multiple customer projects simultaneously.
* You thrive in customer\-facing environments, facilitating workshops and executive\-level conversations with confidence.
* You have excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of translating technical concepts into clear, actionable steps.
* You are consultative by nature, with the humility to listen and the confidence to challenge firms to rethink their processes.
* You have a strong attention to detail and pride yourself on accuracy and follow\-through.
* You enjoy working with data and systems, ensuring integrity throughout migrations and configuration.
* You are resilient and adaptable, thriving in dynamic environments where change is constant.
* You are comfortable working remotely and managing your time independently.


**Bonus points if you have:**


* Experience in the accounting or tax industry.
* Previous experience with workflow, accounting, or project management software.
* Background in software onboarding or enterprise implementations.
* Knowledge of change management frameworks.
* Experience in a startup or high\-growth SaaS environment.
* Deep knowledge and hands\-on experience using Karbon.

  


**Why work at Karbon?**


* Gain global experience across the USA, Australia, New Zealand, UK, Canada and the Philippines
* Excellent benefits package including:
* + Paid Flexible Time Off with an encouraged 3 weeks use per year
	+ Company paid medical for you and eligible spouse/partner and dependents
	+ Company paid dental and vision and eligible spouse/partner and dependents
	+ Fully company funded short and long term disability
	+ Fully company paid life insurance
	+ 401(k) with company matching
	+ Flexible Spending Account
	+ Up to 8 weeks paid parental leave
	+ Work\-from\-home stipend
* Work with (and learn from) an experienced, high\-performing team
* A collaborative, team\-oriented culture that embraces diversity, invests in development and provides consistent feedback
* Be part of a fast\-growing company that firmly believes in promoting high performers from within

**Please be aware that Karbon will only contact you via email from our domain, karbonhq.com. If you receive an email from any other domain, please do not click any of those links.**



Karbon embraces diversity and inclusion, aligning with our values as a business. Research has shown that women and underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single criteria. If you've made it this far in the job description but your past experience doesn't perfectly align, we do encourage you to still apply. You could still be the right person for the role!

We don't discriminate based on race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lifestyle, age, educational background, national origin, religion, physical or cognitive ability, and other diversity dimensions that may hinder inclusion in the organization.



Generally, if you are a good person, we want to talk to you.

We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.


The Implementation Consultant I will oversee the deployment and implementation of the Entri Product Suite. They will engage with the client, hospital operations and applications/infrastructure teams to design, build, and implement the patient and user experience solutions. This position will also assist with upholding standard workflows and create educational materials to prepare for go lives. The Implementation Consultant I will be responsible to hold all stakeholders accountable in the delivery of the solution.


A successful candidate will exhibit the ability to lead a cross\-functional project to build and operationalize a business to consumer solution, be expected to identify subject matter experts to solve for potential obstacles, meet project deadlines and identify, escalate or resolve any issues that would impact the ability to deliver on the solution. They are expected to have strong communication skills to inform and engage key stakeholders across various levels with project updates and/or escalations. The Implementation Consultant I will propose new opportunities for efficiencies, enhancement, and expansion of product and process initiatives. This role is the entry level position into Configuration and Deployment and initially works on a limited product scope, with the opportunity and expectation to learn and progress quickly.


**Essential Responsibilities**

* Manages on\-time and competent delivery of application database build. Self\-motivation is critical to the success of this position.
* Provides support to the entire deployment team and actively communicates between all stakeholders.
* Consults with the client and project team to define and obtain the data necessary to build applications based on the scope of the contract and client needs, and within the timeline and budget.
* Uses a creative problem\-solving approach to analyze data along with workflow to determine standard best practice processes to gain efficiencies.
* Collaborates with the client, operations, training, IT and support team members to meet project timelines. Motivates stakeholders to execute operational change and achieve desired results.
* Ability to deliver clear and concise training, objectives, and expectations to end users, and collaborate with stakeholders to design educational materials.
* Leads the client in database validation and conducts functional and integrated testing to ensure readiness for successful go lives.
* Actively seeks to understand the challenges and needs in the health care industry, particularly in the patient access arena.

**Skills**

* Proficient computer skills (including, but not limited to, Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Visio) are required.
* Highly organized, strong interpersonal skills and clear and concise oral and written communication skills.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, office staff, and peers.
* Strong problem solving, analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Results and deadline driven, working well under high pressure situations while staying resourceful, tactful, and adjust to rapidly changing needs from the customer.

**Other Qualifications**

* 2\+ years Healthcare/Technology experience.
* Understanding of HIPAA and importance of privacy of patient data.

For this US\-based position, the base pay range is $54,661\.00 \- $85,842\.89 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Implementation
jobs.description:
**Senior Director \- Implementation**

**About Kipu**


At Kipu Health, we’re passionate about creating better paths to better patient care. Join us in our work to advance behavioral health care in our communities. Our innovative solutions support providers in treating addiction, eating disorders and many other behavioral health conditions. While our EMR, CRM and revenue cycle solutions help behavioral health facilities succeed in managing their patients’ entire care journey, it’s through our people that we truly make a difference.

**Job Description**


The Senior Director, Implementation is responsible for leading the successful delivery of Kipu’s EMR and related software implementations for new and existing clients. This role oversees a multi‑layered organization of Directors, Managers, and Implementation Specialists, ensuring consistent execution, scalable delivery, and high‑quality client outcomes.


This leader defines and reinforces how Kipu “shows up” in Implementation, driving a culture centered on client outcomes, proactive execution, accountability, and adoption readiness. The role partners closely with Sales, Product, Customer Success, Finance and coordinating with third‑party partners to deliver seamless, high‑impact client experiences.


Success in this role requires building a high‑performing organization that consistently executes against Kipu’s implementation best practices, ensuring clients are fully prepared to adopt, operate, and realize long‑term value from Kipu’s solutions.

**Your Responsibilities**

* Lead a multi‑tiered implementation organization (Directors, Managers, and Implementation Specialists I\-III), ensuring alignment, accountability, and performance across all levels.
* Establish and operationalize implementation standards and best practices across discovery, solution design, configuration, training, documentation, and go‑live readiness.
* Ensure teams consistently prioritize client outcomes over task completion, driving adoption, confidence, and long‑term success.
* Drive a culture of proactive execution and accountability, including early risk identification, active issue management (RAID), and clear ownership of outcomes.
* Oversee end‑to‑end implementation delivery, ensuring structured, high‑quality execution across discovery, configuration, data validation, training, go‑live, and early adoption.
* Ensure discovery and solution design practices are rigorous, client‑centric, and aligned to operational realities \- not just product capabilities.
* Champion high‑quality training and knowledge transfer, ensuring clients can confidently execute workflows independently prior to go‑live.
* Enforce go‑live readiness as a quality gate, ensuring clients are prepared for adoption rather than driven by timelines alone.
* Drive excellence in client communication and meeting leadership, ensuring interactions are structured, outcome‑driven, and build trust.
* Ensure strong documentation discipline and transparency, with accurate, real‑time visibility across Slack, Salesforce, and project artifacts.
* Partner collaboratively across internal teams—Sales, Product, Customer Success, Support, and Operations—to ensure aligned, seamless client experiences.
* Build and manage relationships with third‑party partners, ensuring coordinated delivery, accountability, and alignment to Kipu standards.
* Own capacity planning, resource strategy, and utilization in alignment with forecasted demand and growth targets.
* Act as an escalation point for complex or high‑risk client situations, ensuring resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators, including time‑to‑go‑live, adoption readiness, quality of execution, and client satisfaction outcomes.
* Coach and develop Directors and Managers to reinforce consistent execution, raise performance standards, and scale organizational capability.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying patterns, evolving playbooks, and incorporating feedback from clients, teams, and performance data.
* Own, in partnership with the VP of Professional Services, implementation services financial performance, including forecast accuracy, utilization, and services revenue attainment.
* Travel required up to 25%

**Your Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of experience in software implementation, professional services, or customer delivery, preferably in SaaS or healthcare technology environments.
* 5\+ years of leadership experience managing multi‑layered teams (e.g., Managers and Directors) in implementation or services organizations.
* Proven ability to scale teams with defined role progression (e.g., Specialist I–III) while maintaining consistency, quality, and accountability.
* Strong alignment to operational excellence principles, including structured delivery, risk management, and standardized execution.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a culture of proactive ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working collaboratively across internal functions to deliver unified client outcomes.
* Experience managing and coordinating with third‑party vendors and implementation partners.
* Strong communication and executive presence, with the ability to lead client interactions and influence internal stakeholders.
* Deep experience in project delivery, including scope management, timelines, and risk mitigation.
* Experience with CRM, AI and service delivery tools (e.g., Salesforce, Jira, Zendesk, PSA tools, Claude, etc).
* Working knowledge of healthcare workflows and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA, PHI, EDI, etc); behavioral health experience preferred.

**Benefits \& Compensation**

* Highly competitive salary based on your local market’s compensation data.
* Flexible paid time off.
* 11 Paid Holidays.
* Health, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance.
* Parental Leave.
* Pet Insurance.
* 401(K) with Company Match.
* Career Path Program.

**Mission**


Kipu’s mission is to empower caregivers and patients on every step of the recovery journey. By expanding Kipu’s ecosystem of innovative applications and services, Kipu helps treatment centers achieve the best outcomes across all levels of care, improving the individual, community, and public health.Kipu values and celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe creating teams made up of individuals with various backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives inspires innovation, collaboration, and challenges us to produce better solutions.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, AI & Voice
jobs.description:
Description:
**About Birdeye**


Birdeye is the leading agentic marketing platform for multi\-location brands.


Companies like H\&R Block, Aspen Dental, and Caesars Entertainment use Birdeye to manage marketing across thousands of locations — from how they get found, to how they convert, to how they retain customers. Our platform replaces disconnected point tools with AI agents that execute work at the location level — responding to reviews, updating listings, publishing content, and driving conversions.


Backed by Marc Benioff, Jerry Yang, and Accel\-KKR, Birdeye was named to G2’s 2026 Best Agentic AI Products list — appearing alongside the world’s leading AI companies. We’re expanding rapidly into enterprise, with growing adoption across large, multi\-location brands.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a customer\-focused Implementation Specialist to own the end\-to\-end deployment of Birdeye's AI and voice solutions. This role will work closely with customers, IT teams, FDEs, Product, and Engineering to configure, test, and launch solutions successfully.


This is a customer\-facing implementation and configuration role, not a backend engineering role.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own implementations from kickoff through go\-live, including timelines, milestones, risks, and customer communication.
* Execute integration playbooks and coordinate EHR/PMS and third\-party integrations.
* Configure providers, appointment types, availability, widgets, knowledge bases, and other product settings.
* Configure AI agents, including workflows, procedures, prompts, guardrails, and customer\-specific business rules.
* Be comfortable understanding customer requirements and translating them into effective agent workflows and experiences.
* Coordinate telephony setup and call\-forwarding with customer IT/telephony teams.
* Lead UAT, end\-to\-end testing, go\-live, and post\-launch validation.
* Identify risks and technical dependencies early and coordinate resolution with FDE/Engineering.
* Maintain accurate implementation documentation and continuously improve implementation playbooks.
* Voice Agent Tuning: Continuously tune voice agent workflows, prompts, procedures, and guardrails based on customer requirements, UAT results, and real\-world call behavior to improve accuracy and customer experience.
* Post\-Launch Call Reviews: Conduct regular post\-launch call reviews to identify gaps, incorrect responses, workflow issues, and opportunities to improve

**What This Role Does NOT Own**

* Backend tooling or custom backend logic
* Building or modifying APIs or engineering tools
* Custom engineering/SOW development
* Backend security/compliance logic
* Engineering\-level debugging of backend tooling


These requirements will be identified and coordinated with FDE/Engineering, while


Implementation owns the customer communication, testing, and delivery.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 3–7 years of SaaS implementation, technical onboarding, professional services, or similar experience.
* Strong project management and customer\-facing communication skills.
* Comfortable with integrations, workflows, APIs, and technical concepts.
* Comfortable configuring AI/voice agents and translating business requirements into agent workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and cross\-functional technical teams.
* Ability to manage multiple implementations and drive projects to completion.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, conversational AI, voice, contact center, or telephony solutions.
* Experience with healthcare EHR/PMS platforms.
* Experience with UAT and enterprise go\-live processes.

**Why You’ll Join Us**


At Birdeye, we are relentless innovators driven by a singular goal: to lead our category with unparalleled excellence. We don't just set goals – we surpass them. We're a team of doers who roll up our sleeves and get the job done, delivering on our promises with unwavering dedication.


Working here means embracing a culture of action and accountability, where every person is empowered to make an impact. We don't just talk about making a difference – we make it happen.

**Benefits**

* 100% Employer\-paid benefit plans available for employees with multiple health plan options (HSA, PPO)
* Flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Flexible work from home options available
* Maternity \& Paternity Leave
* Employee Resource Groups \- network with like\-minded "Birds"
* Abundant opportunities that come with a dynamic and fast\-growing organization!

jobs.title: Clinical Systems Training Specialist, Praxis Health
jobs.description:
Praxis Health is looking for a **Clinical Systems Training Specialist** who builds and delivers the education clinic staff and providers need to work effectively in Praxis Health's clinical systems, with an initial focus on the Oracle Health EHR implementation. The role covers both halves of that work: designing training content and materials and delivering it directly to end users.



The role works closely with the Clinical Systems Manager and coordinates with Directors of Operations, RLCMs, and Regional Clinic Provider Leads to schedule training and address workflow readiness.


**Location \& Schedule**


* **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
* **Location:** Flexible hybrid schedule based on events, meetings, and other business needs.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design training curriculum and materials for clinical systems, including the Oracle Health EHR, tailored to different clinic roles (providers, front desk, clinical staff).
* Deliver live training sessions, both in person and virtual, for clinic staff and providers.
* Develop and maintain quick reference guides, job aids, and other supporting training materials.
* Support go\-live and cutover activities for the Oracle Health EHR implementation, including at\-the\-elbow support during go\-live periods.
* Identify training gaps by working with clinic staff, providers, and the Clinical Systems Specialists on recurring issues that point to a training need rather than a system issue.
* Develop and deliver training on new technology and system updates as they roll out, working with the Clinical Systems Specialists to translate technical changes into end\-user education.
* Design and adapt training for AI\-enabled clinic tools, including ambient documentation and AI scribes, as adoption changes clinical workflows and how staff document.
* Coordinate training scheduling with Directors of Operations and RLCMs to minimize disruption to clinic operations.
* Gather and incorporate feedback from training sessions to improve future sessions and materials.
* Champion innovative approaches to training and education, using new tools and methods to make learning clinical systems more effective for staff and providers.
* Partner with Clinical Revenue Cycle, Population Health, Consumer Experience, and other departments to provide continuing education to end users as appropriate.


**What You Bring**


* Comfortable both designing training content and delivering it live to a range of audiences, from providers to front desk staff.
* Strong communication and facilitation skills; able to adapt teaching style to different roles and comfort levels with technology.
* Organized and able to manage a training schedule across multiple clinics and regions.
* Comfortable identifying training gaps by distinguishing recurring issues that point to a training need from those that point to a system issue.
* Champions innovative approaches to training and education, using new tools and methods to make learning clinical systems more effective for staff and providers.
* Comfortable gathering and incorporating feedback from training sessions to improve future sessions and materials.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* 3 to 5 years of experience in training or education, ideally in a clinical or healthcare setting.
* Experience training clinical or healthcare staff on an EHR or other clinical system.
* Demonstrated ability to design training curriculum and materials tailored to different roles, not only deliver existing content.
* Experience developing and maintaining supporting training materials such as quick reference guides and job aids.
* Ability to coordinate training scheduling with operational stakeholders across multiple sites or regions.
* Experience building or establishing a training program from the ground up that has proven durable through subsequent system or organizational changes.

  


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Cerner or Oracle Health.
* Exposure to AI tools in a healthcare setting; experience training staff on AI scribes or ambient documentation a plus.


**About Our Company**



Praxis Health is a family of medical groups providing high\-quality healthcare throughout the state of Oregon. Our community\-based clinics are the DNA of our business, providing better medicine, advocacy for our patients, and a satisfying and collaborative culture for our providers and staff. The Praxis family approach is dynamically different from other healthcare companies in Oregon. We are not "big box" health care, but rather a company of small groups and clinics, of nimble micro\-cultures that can quickly adapt to industry changes, as well as patient needs. We have been serving communities across the beautiful and adventurous state of Oregon for over 50 years! And we are pioneers and thought leaders in the industry. Our commitment to innovative and operational excellence has allowed us to create healthcare solutions that are both cost\-efficient and cutting edge. Come see how healthcare is done right!


**General Physical Requirements**



Manual dexterity for office machine operation including computer and calculator; stooping, bending to handle files and supplies, mobility to complete errands for deliveries, or sitting for extended periods of time. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Stress can be triggered by multiple staff demands and deadlines.

jobs.description:
**Manager, Professional Services (Clinical Implementation \& Regulatory/MIPS)**
===============================================================================

**Location:** Remote (designated states)

**Department:** Professional Services

**Role Model:** Operational Player\-Coach (50/50 Split between Clinical Implementation Management and Regulatory/MIPS Expertise)


The **Manager, Professional Services (Clinical Implementation \& Regulatory/MIPS)** operates as an operational player\-coach. This role provides day\-to\-day managerial leadership to an aligned clinical implementation team while acting as the centralized subject matter expert for clinical regulatory compliance (MIPS) and quality reporting. The Manager balances team capacity, coaching, and product launch readiness (Beta to General Availability) with driving client governance strategies and overseeing complex compliance implementations.

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

### **People Management \& Clinical Team Leadership (50%)**

* **Team Leadership \& Mentorship:** Provide day\-to\-day managerial leadership for direct reports, including 1:1 meetings, career pathing, development opportunities, and performance management
* **Consultative Coaching \& Upskilling:** Actively teach, coach, and upskill consultants on advanced consultative techniques, empowering them to navigate difficult client conversations regarding software updates, clinical workflows, and industry mandates
* **Capacity \& Operational Planning:** Oversee project assignments, monitor active backlogs, track team capacity, and maintain target utilization rates to ensure balanced workloads
* **Product Launch \& Readiness:** Partner closely with Product Management during Closed and Open Beta phases to evaluate feature readiness, align deployment timelines, and author internal consulting playbooks from Beta to GA
* **Continuous Improvement \& AI Optimization:** Establish post\-implementation reviews to systematically eliminate delivery friction points, reduce Time\-to\-Value (TTV), and integrate modern AI tools to automate administrative tasks and scale consultancy output
* **Personal Portfolio:** Maintain player\-coach capacity by directly managing a selective personal portfolio of 1–2 strategic or early\-adopter implementations

### **Regulatory \& MIPS Strategy Leadership (50%)**

* **Regulatory Authority \& Governance:** Act as the team\-wide authority on healthcare quality reporting programs (MIPS, Meaningful Use, private payer initiatives), driving client governance strategies and compliance attestation natively within software workflows
* **Enablement \& Framework Development:** Develop comprehensive internal training frameworks, documentation, and playbooks so the entire implementation team can independently consult on and deploy regulatory workflows
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Serve as the main bridge between Professional Services and Product Management to continually evaluate regulatory enhancements and ensure software compliance standards
* **Client \& Escalation Lead:** Serve as the primary escalation point for complex client regulatory issues, compliance audits, and high\-stakes implementation commitments
* **Quality Assurance:** Oversee testing, training, and QA activities across implementations to guarantee alignment with clinical/regulatory benchmarks while maintaining an onboarding CSAT score of 95%\+

**Position Proficiencies and Requirements**
-------------------------------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. An active or past clinical degree (PT/OT/SLT) is a strong plus
* **Leadership Experience:** Minimum of 2 years of formal people management or team lead experience with a proven track record of developing team culture, managing utilization, and coaching direct reports
* **Implementation \& Project Experience:** 3 to 5 years of experience managing complex projects or implementation teams, ideally within an ambulatory EMR/EHR space
* **Regulatory Expertise:** Minimum of 2 years of hands\-on operational or consultative experience managing healthcare quality reporting programs (including MIPS) and translating regulatory mandates into software workflows
* **Operational Skills:** Demonstrated understanding of capacity management, resource allocation, and tracking Professional Services KPIs (utilization, TTV, CSAT). Proven experience building playbooks for software release lifecycles (Beta to GA)
* **Technology \& AI Agility:** Strong knowledge of medical billing, scheduling, and clinical documentation software Demonstrated capability in adopting AI tools and digital workflow software to streamline daily consulting routines

**Competencies to Drive Success**
---------------------------------

* **Continuous Improvement Mindset:** Relentlessly evaluates broken delivery models, conducts post\-mortems, and iterates on deployment playbooks
* **Regulatory Consultation Command:** Instills team\-wide mastery of compliance benchmarks and leads clients through technical/regulatory processes with authority
* **Operational Readiness \& Launch Management:** Accurately forecasts capacity, coordinates cross\-functional readiness, and prepares teams for major product launches
* **Consultative Teaching \& Mentorship:** Inspires team members through hands\-on coaching and effective dissemination of specialized compliance skills
* **Context\-Switching Agility:** Seamlessly transitions between direct\-report coaching, product meetings, regulatory strategy, and client escalations


At Raintree, we’re not just shaping the future of therapy technology – we’re creating it. This is your chance to be part of something bigger, where your career will have **game\-changing, career\-defining moments** that propel you to new heights. **We aim to be the best place for the best people**, and we’re looking for ambitious, creative thinkers ready to make an impact. Whether you’re advancing AI solutions or enhancing user experiences, your work here will shape the future of therapy technology while advancing your career alongside dedicated professionals who are as committed to your success as you are. At Raintree, your ideas drive real change, your growth is limitless, and the work you do will touch millions of lives. Ready to ignite your career and leave a lasting legacy? jobs.title: Technical Application SME – Federal Health Information Systems
jobs.description:
**Company:** Native American Industrial Solutions LLC (NAIS)

**Location:** National Captial Region

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Position Status:** Contingent upon contract award

**Security Requirement:** Ability to obtain and maintain the required federal suitability determination, security clearance, and system access

**Position Overview**


NAIS is seeking a senior Technical Application Subject Matter Expert to support the sustainment, integration, and continued development of mission\-critical federal health information systems.


The Technical Application SME will provide senior technical leadership across application development, systems analysis, database technologies, data architecture, data warehousing, testing, networking, integration, and production support. The position will work closely with functional SMEs, government stakeholders, cybersecurity personnel, and multidisciplinary engineering teams.


This position is designated as Key Personnel. Employment is contingent upon contract award, customer approval, and successful completion of applicable security, suitability, and onboarding requirements.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide senior technical guidance for the sustainment and enhancement of enterprise health applications.
* Translate functional requirements into secure, supportable technical designs and implementation approaches.
* Advise teams on application architecture, software design, business logic, databases, data models, interfaces, and data\-processing workflows.
* Support requirements analysis, system design, development, integration, testing, deployment, and production\-readiness activities.
* Evaluate proposed technical changes for feasibility, interoperability, performance, security, maintainability, and operational risk.
* Guide integration among applications, databases, data repositories, analytical environments, external systems, and medical devices.
* Support database design, administration, engineering, performance optimization, backup, recovery, and continuity activities.
* Support data architecture, data\-warehouse management, data validation, transformation, reporting, and analytics.
* Advise on the integration of occupational and environmental health exposure information into enterprise data repositories.
* Support application and database troubleshooting, defect resolution, incident response, outage management, and production operations.
* Participate in technical reviews, code\-quality reviews, test planning, release\-readiness assessments, and risk\-management activities.
* Support interfaces that transmit clinical data from diagnostic equipment, including audiometers, into enterprise systems.
* Coordinate technical activities across developers, systems analysts, database personnel, data engineers, testers, network specialists, cybersecurity staff, and functional SMEs.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, architectural materials, interface specifications, data documentation, operating procedures, and decision records.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies, alternatives, and recommendations to program leadership and government stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* Senior\-level experience supporting enterprise information technology or software\-development environments.
* Demonstrated experience in one or more relevant technical disciplines, such as application development, systems analysis, database administration, database engineering, data architecture, data warehousing, networking, or software testing.
* Knowledge of software\-development lifecycles, application functionality, business logic, databases, data processing, interfaces, integration, and production support.
* Experience analyzing complex technical problems and developing practical, supportable solutions.
* Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary software, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, testing, and mission teams.
* Strong technical\-writing, documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical matters to government leaders, mission users, and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to satisfy applicable federal suitability, security\-clearance, system\-access, and onboarding requirements.

**Preferred Experience**

* Senior\-level experience supporting occupational and environmental health, military health, medical\-readiness, clinical, or comparable federal health systems.
* Knowledge of occupational and environmental health business practices and exposure information.
* Experience with the design, architecture, data models, and integration of defense health or exposure information.
* Experience supporting application development and systems analysis for mission\-critical enterprise systems.
* Experience as an Application Developer, Application Systems Analyst, Systems Analyst, Database Administrator, Database Engineer, Database Specialist, Data Architect, Data Warehouse Specialist, Network Specialist, or Test Engineer.
* Experience with relational databases, data repositories, data warehouses, ETL or ELT processes, reporting, analytics, and data\-quality controls.
* Experience with APIs, enterprise interfaces, interoperability, and secure data exchange.
* Experience integrating medical devices or diagnostic equipment with enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of protocols and data\-capture interfaces used to transmit clinical data from audiometers or comparable diagnostic equipment.
* Experience supporting development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Experience with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid software\-development methodologies.
* Experience supporting release management, configuration management, testing, defect resolution, deployment, and production operations.
* Experience working within Department of Defense or other federal information\-technology environments.

**Work Environment**


The place of performance is associated with Falls Church, Virginia. The final onsite, remote, or hybrid work arrangement will be determined by contract and customer requirements.


The position may require collaboration with geographically distributed government, military, clinical, cybersecurity, and engineering stakeholders. Occasional travel may be required based on final program needs.

**Application**


Please submit a résumé demonstrating senior\-level experience in applicable software\-development, systems\-analysis, database, data\-architecture, data\-warehouse, network, integration, or testing disciplines. Applicants should clearly identify their primary technical specialty and any relevant federal health, military health, medical\-device, or occupational and environmental health experience.


Candidates selected for proposal submission will be asked to provide a signed letter of intent or commitment and documentation needed to verify qualifications and security eligibility.


This position is contingent upon contract award, customer approval of Key Personnel, and successful completion of applicable federal security, suitability, and onboarding requirements.


NAIS is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
**The Organization**


North Los Angeles County Regional Center “NLACRC” is a private, non\-profit agency that is contracted with the State of California, Department of Developmental Services, to provide services to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. NLACRC is one of the largest regional centers in California and has proudly served the San Fernando Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, and Antelope Valley since 1974\. We serve individuals across the lifespan from infants and toddlers, school age children, transition\-age youth, to adults and aging adults.

**Supervision**


Receives general supervision from the Training and Development Supervisor.

**The Position and Job Summary**


The Training Specialist II maintains training transcripts for staff in accordance with strategic initiatives set by the Training and Development Supervisor. They actively participate as a trainer in new hire training and other assigned trainings. They maintain all facets of the Learning Management System including, but not limited to user experience, automation, and programming of course enrollments, branding, and record management. Additionally, they serve as an instructional designer, provide recommendations, and prepare analysis for strategic reports to the Training and Development Supervisor.

**Employment Standards**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

* Available as a resource for the Training Specialist I as it relates to coordination of NLACRC trainings with trainers and staff. Provides additional support as needed.
* Tracks NLACRC new staff progress through New Staff Orientation (NSO) learning paths and informs staff, supervisors and the Training and Development Supervisor as needed. Analyzes post\-survey data to provide recommendations for upgrades to NSO courses, programs, and systems.
* Participates as a trainer for NSO training protocols and other training initiatives as assigned by the Training and Development Supervisor.
* Maintains and updates the user interface for the Learning Management System (LMS) front\-end to improve staff experience. Collaborates with the LMS developer to resolve technical issues related to LMS efficiencies.
